verdict.rationale: Token2's management tools (desktop and mobile companion apps, the fido2-manage CLI and Python GUI, the PIV miniDriver, and browser tools) could plausibly offer a natural-language interface, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows conventional GUI and command-line operation, with no natural-language or conversational control. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI all returned 404, so nothing suggests AI-driven operation.
